[url=https://thinkygames.com/direct/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7938465/372b23a7e25a050b8939c060efbb853956831ad2.png[/img][/url]

- Gamepad dpad works on levels
- Changed buttons for going to previous and next level
- Changed behavior and availability of the main menu exit button depending on platform
